notes: call_count counts distinct observed attempts, including failed calls; completion records do not increment it.
Duplicate source IDs must agree. Cross-source calls merge only with an explicit shared session/call_id and equal path.
Evidence references per aggregate are capped at 64; full references remain in events.jsonl.
Native Codex/AgentCore schema mapping and correctness require real original captures; envelope support alone is not validation.
Session-partitioned workers resolve lineage against an immutable disk index; external sort and reduction are serial.
